convention_conflict.quantity: Goncharov geometric constant C in u_b = sqrt(2Ag/((1+A)Ck))

primary.source: arXiv:1910.03663 Fig. 3 caption p.6 (2-D RTI, A = 0.04), Fr_B = sqrt(1/(3*pi)); equivalent to the classic 2-D Layzer value u_b = sqrt(2Ag/(3k))

alternate.source: arXiv:2009.14655 Eq. (1) p.3, verbatim 'C is a constant given by 1 or 3 for the two-dimensional or three-dimensional geometry'

convention_conflict.status: UNRESOLVED (publisher copy of Goncharov 2002 PRL 88:134502 not reachable: HTTP 403)
convention_conflict.policy: gates use C = 3 (2-D-specific primary source); both errors are reported; no constant is fitted to solver output
